description: Replace an installed app with a binary from a local path. Use this when preserving the same app identity while installing a new build on the selected device. Local Android and iOS install steps time out after 120s; the command allows 480s including device startup and uninstall. Times out after 480s.

device.description: Device name; ids go in udid or serial.

deviceBaseline.description: Proxy lease: saved device state (baseline) to restore on the leased device. Honored only by a proxy backend that leases by spec; other daemons refuse it.

deviceMode.description: Proxy lease: iOS simulator mode, slim or full. Honored only by a proxy backend that leases by spec; other daemons refuse it.

imageTag.description: Proxy lease: Android system image tag, for example google_apis_playstore. Honored only by a proxy backend that leases by spec; other daemons refuse it.

includeCost.description: Add agent cost (cost.wallClockMs, …) to the result, returned as JSON text.

mcpOutputFormat.description: Result text: compact optimized (default) or the full result as JSON (larger).

osVersion.description: Proxy lease: OS version or range, for example 18.6.2 or ">=26" (Android: API level). Honored only by a proxy backend that leases by spec; other daemons refuse it.

physical.description: Proxy lease: true requests a physical device; false selects nothing. Honored only by a proxy backend that leases by spec; other daemons refuse it.

responseLevel.description: Result detail: digest (smallest) or full (largest), as JSON; default is compact text.

serial.description: Android, HarmonyOS, or Vega VVD serial.

name: reinstall
